method: Current on-chain holdings of Aoki's two NFT wallets (0xa6d3a33a1c66083859765b9d6e407d095a908193, 0xe4bbcbff51e61d0d95fcc5016609ac8354b177c4) per acquired collection, via Alchemy getNFTsForOwner filtered by contract (top 10 acquired collections). 'purchases' counts distinct buy events from the acquisitions ledger; 'held_now' is the live owned-count. held_now < purchases means some were sold; the ETH that reached Aoki was fungible, so no token is attributed to MetaZoo money.
